en.headline: Redeveloped Huanggang Port opens at 6.30am with joint clearance
en.dek: The new port began 24-hour operations this morning, with the first passengers using collaborative inspection that aims to cut clearance to about five minutes.
body: The redeveloped Huanggang Port between Hong Kong and Shenzhen opened for 24-hour passenger and vehicle clearance at 6.30am on Monday.

The first travellers used the new collaborative inspection and one-time release arrangements inside the joint building. Officials have said the system allows people to queue once and complete both sides' checks, cutting overall clearance from around 30 minutes at the old crossing to about five minutes.

The port is designed for about 200,000 passenger trips a day and remains open around the clock. At the same time, passenger services at the temporary building of the old Huanggang Port and the Lok Ma Chau Control Point ended. The final northbound Yellow Bus to the old port had left San Tin earlier in the morning.

zh.headline: 新皇崗口岸今早6時半開通 首批旅客以合作查驗過關
zh.dek: 重建後皇崗口岸周一清晨6時半正式開通，提供24小時通關，首批旅客使用合作查驗一次放行模式。
body: 重建後的皇崗口岸今早清晨6時半正式開通，為旅客及客運車輛提供24小時通關服務。
首批南下及北上旅客以「合作查驗、一次放行」模式過關。官方指，旅客只需排一次隊、查一次證件便可完成兩地手續，整體通關時間由舊口岸約30分鐘縮短至約5分鐘。
口岸設計每日處理約20萬人次，維持全天候運作。舊皇崗口岸臨時大樓及落馬洲管制站的旅檢服務同時結束。往舊口岸的尾班皇巴已於較早時間由新田開出。
